title: A test-retest resting and cognitive state EEG dataset
description: This dataset provides test-retest EEG recordings from 60 participants across three experimental sessions. It includes resting states (eyes closed, eyes open) and cognitive states (subtraction, music, memory). Recordings are accompanied by measures of sleep, emotion, mental health, and mind-wandering.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Brain Products system using 64 electrodes at a 500 Hz sampling rate, with impedances kept below 5 kΩ. Data were collected between September 2019 and April 2021 across three sessions per participant.
